slides.title: Must, have to, should, could
slides.subtitle: Modales de obligación, consejo y habilidad pasada
goals: Expresar prohibición con **mustn't** y falta de obligación con **don't have to**.
Dar consejos con **should** y hablar de habilidad pasada con **could**.

slides.title: Significados

head: Modal
Significado
Ejemplo
rows: You **don't have to** come. It's optional.
I **could** swim when I was five.

slides.watch: **mustn't** ≠ **don't have to**. *You mustn't go* = está prohibido; *You don't have to go* = no estás obligado.

items.es: Los alumnos deben mostrar su credencial.

items.en: She has to take the bus at 6.
items.es: Tiene que tomar el camión a las 6.

items.en: You don't have to pay. It's free.
items.es: No tienes que pagar. Es gratis.

items.q: It's a secret. You ___ tell anyone.
Tomorrow is a holiday. We ___ get up early.
You look tired. You ___ go to bed.
When I was a child I ___ ride a bike.

items.t: You ___ study for the exam. It's important. (consejo)
I ___ go. My boss says so. (obligación)
She ___ speak English when she was 10. (negativa, pasado)
